from bisect import bisect_left

def taller_within(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    if k == 0:
        return [0] * n

    vals = sorted(set(a))
    ranks = [bisect_left(vals, x) for x in a]
    m = len(vals)
    bit = [0] * (m + 1)

    def add(p: int, d: int) -> None:
        p += 1
        while p <= m:
            bit[p] += d
            p += p & -p

    def prefix(p: int) -> int:
        p += 1
        s = 0
        while p > 0:
            s += bit[p]
            p -= p & -p
        return s

    res = [0] * n
    for i, r in enumerate(ranks):
        size = i if i < k else k
        res[i] = size - prefix(r)

        add(r, 1)
        out = i - k
        if out >= 0:
            add(ranks[out], -1)

    return res
